Team —

Thanks again for taking the loop with Nadia yesterday (Senior ML Infra Engineer). Quick ask to help me close the loop and determine next steps: please either fill the attached scorecard_template.xlsx or reply inline with the numeric scores + two-line rationale by EOD tomorrow (2027-12-15 17:00 PT).

Interview coverage (for reference):
- Jonas: system design / infra architecture
- Marissa: model serving + reliability
- Karthik: coding / debugging exercise
- Laura: product sense & cross-functional fit

Please score on these axes (1-5): Technical, System Design, Product/Collab, Communication, Overall Hire Recommendation. If you have a hard blocker (misaligned expectations, red-flag on ownership, etc.), call it out explicitly.

Decision rule: if the panel median Overall >=4 and no blockers -> move to hiring committee for compensation ask. If median 3 or mixed, I will schedule a 30m sync to resolve differences.

Attachments: candidate CV (nadia_russo_cv.pdf) and scorecard template. Greenhouse link: https://greenhouse.example.com/candidates/GR-9327

Thanks — short and specific notes appreciated.

Hannah

Hannah / all — putting my scores here:

Technical: 4
System Design: 3
Product/Collab: 4
Communication: 4
Overall Hire Recommendation: 3

Notes: Smart on tradeoffs, but I felt Nadia's architecture choices assumed an in-house orchestration direction that diverges from where platform is heading (we're converging on multi-tenant routing + lighter control-plane). Concern is alignment rather than skill. If we think the role needs strong advocacy for our chosen direction, that could be a mismatch. Not a hard no, but enough that I prefer a brief sync to align on expectations before committee.
